mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (member_id, member_name, password, email, joined_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{memberName}, #{password}, #{email}, COALESCE(#{joinedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
